name: Great Expectations (GX Core)
sku: GX Core, the open-source Python library, Apache 2.0. GX Cloud adds hosted collaboration and monitoring on top and is not scored.

bands.note: Expectations are pass/fail assertions about data (nulls, uniqueness, ranges, custom rules), run as validations against a pipeline's own data sources: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Spark and file formats among them, embedded in code wherever a pipeline calls it (Airflow, Spark, Prefect, dbt and Jupyter are all documented integrations). This is what the library exists to do.

presentation.tagline: Open-source data validation: express expectations about your data, run them anywhere your pipeline does.

cost.note: No licence cost (Apache 2.0), and no separate service to run: it is a library called from compute you already have, so it adds run time to an existing job rather than a bill of its own.
Same as prototype: no licence cost and no separate service. More validations add compute time to the jobs that already call it, not a new line item.
